purpose: Teach: 邦訳/自由民主党/自由党/角川書店/講じる/可用性/外為/用水

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外古典の邦訳本を扱う部署を作りましょう
lines.en: Let's create a department dedicated to publishing translations of overseas classical works.
lines.style: Direct and purposeful opening. Measured pace, clear authority. Inviting without requesting permission. The tone of someone presenting a strategy, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。自由民主党事務所との連絡先を整理しました
lines.en: Done. I've organized the contact information for the LDP office.
lines.style: Quick, efficient affirmation. Light on the opening. No flourish — just reporting progress. The ease of someone who knows exactly what was asked and has delivered.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 自由党側との接触も慎重に進めましょう
lines.en: Let's proceed carefully with outreach to the Liberal Party side as well.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight weight on 'carefully' — not hesitant, but deliberate. The tone of someone navigating sensitive territory with precision, not caution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。角川書店主催のフェアに参加します
lines.en: Understood. We're participating in the Kadokawa book fair.
lines.style: Straightforward update delivered without embellishment. Steady pace, confident. A check-box item reported without apology or over-explanation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リスクに対応策を講じる必要がありますね
lines.en: We should put countermeasures in place for potential risks.
lines.style: Calm, professional. Even weight across the phrase. The phrasing of someone who plans ahead without dramatizing. Slight forward lean in the logic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。システムの可用性を高めるテストを実施中です
lines.en: Yes. We're running tests to increase system reliability right now.
lines.style: Prompt, technical. Clipped rhythm — the efficiency of someone in implementation mode. Brief but substantive. No lingering.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 外為の急変に備えましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare for sudden movements in the foreign exchange markets.
lines.style: Brisk, alert. Sharp attack on the opening. The tone of someone flagging a real concern without panic. Practical readiness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の用水路の補修を依頼しました
lines.en: Understood. I've submitted a request for repairs to the factory's water channel.
lines.style: Final checkoff — slightly quieter, a touch of resolution. Steady close. The last report of the meeting, delivered with quiet completion.
